clues.text: Rebekah's brother, he rushed out to Abraham's servant at the spring after seeing her ring and bracelets.
Rebekah told her son Jacob to flee to this brother of hers in Haran until Esau's fury subsided.
When evening came after the wedding feast, this father gave Jacob his daughter Leah instead of Rachel.
After twenty years of service, Jacob complained that this father-in-law had changed his wages ten times.
While this man was away shearing his sheep, his daughter Rachel stole his household idols.
Chasing Jacob into the hill country of Gilead, this man was warned by God in a dream not to speak good or bad.
He made a covenant with Jacob by a heap of stones, saying, 'May the LORD keep watch between you and me.'
